user_story:
As a user, I want to see notification messages displayed on the notification messages page so that I can be informed of important actions or alerts.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. When I visit the notification messages page at 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/notification_message_rendered', I should see the heading 'Notification Message' in the DOM.
2. The notification message should be displayed within the element with id 'flash-messages'.
3. The footer of the page should indicate 'Powered by Elemental Selenium' within the element with id 'page-footer'.
